class Box(val action: Int)
fun bad(value: Box): Int = value.action(1)

class Box(val action: ((Int) -> Int)?)
fun bad(value: Box): Int = value.action(1)

class Box(val action: (Int) -> Int)
fun bad(value: Box): Int = value.action("wrong")

class Box(val action: (Int) -> Int)
fun bad(value: Box): Int = value.action()

class Box(val action: (Int) -> Int)
fun bad(value: Box): Int = value.action<Int>(1)

class Box(private val action: (Int) -> Int)
fun bad(value: Box): Int = value.action(1)

class Box { val action: (Any?) -> Int = { 3 }; fun action(value: String?): Int = 1; fun action(value: Int?): Int = 2 }
fun bad(value: Box): Int = value.action(null)
